integrity: All analytic claims follow from a polynomial endpoint formula, exact modulus factorizations and a continuous phase-winding argument; finite numerical checks supplement, but do not prove, the infinite assertions. Originality is qualified by publication-priority uncertainty.
scientific_limitations: Only symmetry-axis frequencies and dimensions 3, 5, 7. For dimension 7 the theorem establishes a sequence of cap heights with Fourier zeros and does not classify all such heights, all dimensions, or nonaxial zeros. Classical literature may contain equivalent formulae.
source_ids: Dimitrov–Rusev, Zeros of entire Fourier transforms (2011)
title: Axial Fourier-zero transition for truncated balls in dimensions three, five and seven
